messages:
maya: Quick sync — Boardwalk wants a 4-week POC for a product knowledge assistant. Must support 64k context ingestion, tool-calling to their internal FAQ DB (read/write), and embeddings + reranker. They also asked for a pricing comparison: hosted vs dedicated vs private. Timeline is tight: pilot in 4 weeks. Any immediate blockers?
samir: @maya thanks — can you confirm acceptance criteria? e.g., accuracy thresholds, latency SLO, and what 'tool-calling' obligations are (sync vs async)? Also need a contact for security questionnaire.
ev an: For 64k context we should either use a long-context model (>= 32k) or chunk + retrieve. Running a 70B long-context model will cost more; pragmatic path = embedding store + reranker + a 13B/34B base with tool-calls. Tradeoffs: retrieval latency vs model token cost.
jordan: Ballpark on pricing: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) will be fastest to stand up, ~ $X/day at expected volume. Dedicated reserved capacity reduces per-token but needs a monthly commit. Private (VPC/on-prem) adds setup (~3 weeks) + infra cost. I can pull numbers after we agree scope.
tess-legal: I got the Boardwalk security lead. They'll need KMS integration, SOC2 evidence, and an answer on data residency (EU). Also they pinged about data retention for prompts/logs. I'll start the questionnaire.
kai-infra: For Private/VPC: we can provision the control plane quick but on-prem inference nodes take ops time. If they want GPUs on-prem, estimate 3-4 weeks for procurement + install. VPC-hosted Private deployment is ~2 weeks if they're flexible on AWS account access.
maya: Notes on acceptance criteria from customer: 1) Retrieval precision: top-1 accuracy >= 78% on their test set, 2) rerank nDCG@3 > 0.72, 3) end-to-end p95 latency < 800ms for interactive flows, 4) successful tool-call roundtrip < 1.2s for DB reads. They can provide a 500-sample eval set and sample documents.
ev an: If we do chunk+retrieve, recommend these experiments in POC week 1:
```
- baseline: 13B instruct + sparse retrieval (faiss) -> measure top-1 accuracy
- reranker: 1B reranker model fine-tuned on their QA pairs -> measure nDCG@3
- long-context trial: 32k model with direct context for 50 hardest queries -> measure latency/cost
```
We should capture token-level cost estimates for each run.
samir: @jordan can you prepare two pricing options for the kickoff: hosted with burstable throughput, and dedicated 3-month commit? Also any one-time setup fees for tool integration?
jordan: Yes. I'll draft a slide with three options: hosted (pay-as-you-go), dedicated (1/3/6 month commit tiers), private (setup + infra). I'll throw in estimated per-call costs for the three experiment configs evan listed.
maya: I'll upload the 500-sample eval set and a short prompt deck to the shared drive by EOD. Also pinging @tess-legal to share the security contact.
tess-legal: Adding contact: laura@boardwalk-sec. I'll send them our SOC2 summary + KMS integration notes; asking for any extra compliance forms.
kai-infra: Quick note: for tool-calls we need a simple signing proxy and short-lived creds. We can provide an example connector in the POC (we've done similar with AcmeBank). Deploy-bot: deployment started for demo infra (task 1129).
maya: Great — action items: (1) jordan pricing deck, (2) evan experiment plan + cost estimates, (3) tess kick off security questionnaire, (4) kai provide connector example. Follow-up sync Friday 10am PT.
samir: Sounds good. If we hit blockers on private setup we'll pivot to hosted for the demo. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks all — will share drive links and calendar invite.
